memory.method: Requested live allocation bytes above already-loaded input baseline; separate self/sampled post-exec VmHWM and cgroup usage. Atomic allocator instrumentation included in operation_us. Fresh processes; alternating order; original APIs for both zero-mode builds. Generic/codestream dispatch may differ for nonzero API. No universal RSS/time guarantee.

benchmarks.method: Eight alternating paired processes on one pinned worker CPU, supervisor on another; no concurrent codec build/measurement. Uninstrumented release examples report only timed public-API decode loops; raw output hashes retained. Existing API variants use identical example source/arguments; reduction variants use one example and same iteration counts within each case. Single-host observations.
